note: SAMPLE DATA for the hackathon demo. Replace with real Oldham opportunities and verify every link, phone number and contact before showing it to anyone. Leave a field blank rather than guess. category is one of voluntary, paid_work, social_work. area is one of Central, East, North, South, West or 'All Oldham'. The top-level key is 'services' so directory.py can load it unchanged.

services.name: Volunteer with a local community group (sample)
services.description: Find volunteering roles with community groups and charities across {borough}, from sports clubs to food projects.
services.who_it_is_for: Anyone 16 or over. No experience needed.
services.how_to_access: Browse roles online or drop in and ask for a chat about what suits you.

services.name: Food project volunteer (sample)
services.description: Help sort donations and welcome visitors a few hours a week. Good for teamwork and a reference.
services.how_to_access: Ask at the next session or send a message to say you are interested.

services.name: Duke of Edinburgh's Award (sample)
services.description: Volunteering, a skill, physical activity and an expedition, recognised by employers and colleges.
services.how_to_access: Ask your school, college or youth centre if they run it.

services.name: Get {borough} Working (sample)
services.description: Free help to find a job, apprenticeship or training, with a named adviser and links to local employers.
services.who_it_is_for: {borough} residents looking for work, including young people not in education or work.
services.how_to_access: Book a chat with an adviser.

services.name: Find an apprenticeship
services.description: Search paid apprenticeships near {borough}, from engineering and construction to care and business.
services.who_it_is_for: 16 and over, not in full-time education.
services.how_to_access: Search by postcode district and set up alerts.

services.name: National Careers Service
services.description: Free careers advice, CV help and skills checks, online or by phone.
services.how_to_access: Use the website or ask to speak to an adviser.

services.name: {borough} youth clubs and activities (sample)
services.description: Evening clubs, sport, music and trips with youth workers. A good way to meet people and build confidence.
services.who_it_is_for: 11 to 19, or up to 25 with additional needs.
services.how_to_access: Turn up to a session; no need to book.

services.name: Social care careers taster (sample)
services.description: Find out what working in care and social work is like, with routes into apprenticeships and paid roles.
services.who_it_is_for: 16 and over, interested in helping people.
services.how_to_access: Register interest for the next taster day.

services.name: Young carers group (sample)
services.description: Meet other young people who care for someone at home, get a break, and get support with school or work.
services.who_it_is_for: Young people who help look after a family member.
services.how_to_access: Ask for an introduction or self-refer.
